newsitem.title: FRANCE: CDR seeks buyer for 25 pct stake in Artemis - paper.
newsitem.headline: CDR seeks buyer for 25 pct stake in Artemis - paper.

text.p: The Consortium de Realisation (CDR), the state agency grouping Credit Lyonnais assets to be sold, has retained Goldman Sachs to help find a buyer for its 25 percent stake in Artemis, the holding company of Francois Pinault, the newspaper Le Monde said on Friday.

No one was immediately available at CDR to comment on the report. Le Monde said Goldman was expected to launch a tender for offers soon. It said CDR retained Goldman in the autumn of 1996 to assess the value of the stake. Artemis' assets include 40 percent of retailer Pinault-Printemps-Redoute, U.S. junk bonds, and the Chateau Latour Bordeaux wines.
Financiere Pinault owns 75 percent of Artemis.
Le Monde said Goldman faced a challenge in finding a buyer content to be minority shareholders in an unlisted company. "Who would take the risk if not Francois Pinault himself?" it said.
